name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Bundibugyo Ebola emergency of international concern, declared 17 May, remains in force; no new PHEIC to 12 Nov
state: WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May, and the Director-General told a member state briefing on 11 Nov that it remains one (WHO). UKHSA's outbreaks report for the week to 1 Nov likewise records the PHEIC as continuing. Searches to 13 Nov found no new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so the level stays Watch.
for_you: A PHEIC sets international response measures; it is not a travel ban. Travellers to DR Congo and neighbouring countries can check FCDO travel advice and WHO guidance before going.
rubric_hit: Watch: a PHEIC in effect (Bundibugyo Ebola, declared 17 May; confirmed in force by WHO on 11 Nov); no new PHEIC in 30 days
